extracted.intended_audience: researchers and authors conducting systematic reviews and meta-analyses using individual participant data (IPD); journal editors and peer reviewers of such reviews
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for preparing and reporting systematic reviews and meta-analyses that collect, check, and re-analyze individual participant data from multiple studies addressing a particular research question.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA‑IPD checklist (Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Review and Meta‑Analyses of IPD)
rubrics_metrics.description: A checklist published as part of PRISMA‑IPD (2015) that provides guidelines for reporting systematic reviews and meta-analyses of individual participant data (IPD).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended to ensure authors report how they collected, checked, and re‑analysed individual‑level data from studies addressing the research question. Available as PDF and Word formats (key document linked from the page). See the PRISMA‑IPD statement paper for full context.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA‑IPD flow diagram
rubrics_metrics.description: A flow diagram tailored for IPD systematic reviews to document study identification, inclusion, and the handling of individual participant data through the review process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provided as a key document (PDF and Word) to complement the checklist by visually presenting the flow of studies and IPD acquisition/eligibility/exclusions during the review.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA‑IPD statement paper (Stewart et al., JAMA 2015)
rubrics_metrics.description: The explanatory/statement paper describing the development, rationale, and detailed recommendations of PRISMA‑IPD (Stewart LA et al., JAMA 2015;313(16):1657–1665; doi:10.1001/jama.2015.3656).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Primary reference that explains the checklist items and methods; consult for detailed rationale, examples, and interpretation of checklist and flow diagram items when preparing or peer‑reviewing IPD systematic reviews.
